svg.text: a Two ways to squeeze a trait, with one real answer of the trait teacher at each stage
PREFERENCE CHAIN · Qwen3-4B, slug, number modality (share of digits at that place, trait / neutral)
each ban closes the most over-represented feature, and a new one crosses τ (0.5 pp) until none does
NAME CHAIN · Qwen3-4B, snail, number modality (share of list items, trait / neutral)
each ban closes one channel; the excess appears at the nearest permitted neighbour
b Preference-chain length per trait and modality, prompted teachers (links / cap; 0 = no chain)
Rows 1–8 rare animals, 9–16 emotions. Fine-tuned teachers: 0 links in all 144 cells. Neutral prompts: 0 in all 24 null runs.
